mapper.select: SELECT b.*, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM dimension_artist_balance b LEFT JOIN dimension_user u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_artist_balance (user_id, balance, total_income, total_withdrawn, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{amount}, #{amount}, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE balance = balance + #{amount}, total_income = total_income + #{amount}, update_time = NOW()
INSERT INTO dimension_artist_withdraw (user_id, amount, status, account, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{amount}, 0, #{account}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT w.*, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM dimension_artist_withdraw w LEFT JOIN dimension_user u ON u.id = w.user_id WHERE w.id = #{id}
